title: Lineage fork case, survivor decision and requalification result v1
description: The D-072 record of a detected device-lineage fork: which branches existed, which was selected to survive, what requalifying it required, and on which new lineage generation it resumed. docs/security/INTEGRITY_MODEL.md and docs/security/THREAT_MODEL.md are the normative owners, packages/schemas/planning-schema.sql#lineage_fork_cases and #lineage_fork_branches are the persistence owners, and the lineage-fork-case machine owns the lifecycle. Two rules are structural rather than advisory: every post-fork branch is quarantined before anything else happens, and two commitment chains are never merged — a resolution resumes on a strictly later generation, which is a successor and not a repair.

branches.description: Every branch the fork produced, including the survivor. A resolution that names only the survivor cannot explain what it quarantined, which is exactly what an appeal needs.

state.description: unresolved is not terminal. D-072 makes the resolution appealable, and a denied appeal returns the case to it rather than closing it, so a later appeal is still possible.

detection_basis.description: How the fork was observed. Every value is a deterministic control under the binding rule that deterministic controls are authoritative; none of them is a statistical inference, which D-053 keeps local and advisory.

fork_generation.description: The lineage generation at which the branches diverged. Claims accepted at or before it are preserved, because a fork says nothing about work already accepted.

resumed_generation.description: The new generation the survivor continues on. Strictly greater than fork_generation, which is what keeps a resolution from replaying the fork it resolved.

disposition.description: quarantined claims are held rather than deleted, because the resolution is appealable and an appeal needs the evidence it would otherwise have destroyed.

requalification.description: What the survivor device had to prove before the lineage resumed. It re-establishes continuity on a new generation; it does not merge the quarantined branch's chain into it, and no field here can express such a merge.

reason_code.description: Present on a failed requalification. Drawn from packages/schemas/reason-codes-v1.json.
